translations.web: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: For everyone who behaves dishonestly in regard to these things is detestable to the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: For all that do such things, even all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto Jehovah thy God.
